name: Cast Pane
before_label: the current kit glass, a 256 px tile repeated on every panel
change: Broad, slow thickness waves across the whole pane; slightly thicker at the edges.
good: Most like one cast slab in the current glass colour: slow, broad thickness drift with soft light, and nothing that reads as texture.
watch: Very quiet; over a busy scene its drift can blend with the blurred world behind it.

name: Drawn Sheet
before_label: the current kit glass, a 256 px tile repeated on every panel
change: Long horizontal flow lines, like glass drawn into a sheet while hot.
good: Unmistakably glass: long flow lines catch the light like old drawn window glass.
watch: Its horizontal bands are the most visible pattern; behind text they can read as stripes or water.

name: Rolled Glass
before_label: the current kit glass, a 256 px tile repeated on every panel
change: A gentle, even ripple over the pane, like hand-rolled glass.
good: The most surface character while staying smooth: an all-over gentle ripple with soft light.
watch: Its soft, cloudy patches can read as smoke rather than glass.

name: Deep Jade
before_label: the current kit glass, a 256 px tile repeated on every panel
change: Stronger thickness: deep jade pockets and lighter thin spots, with brighter highlights.
good: The richest jade: deep green pockets and lighter thin spots make the glass's thickness obvious.
watch: The darkest pockets and brightest thin spots are the largest swings in brightness behind text.

name: Clear Slab
before_label: the current kit glass, a 256 px tile repeated on every panel
change: The quietest: almost even glass, a slow drift and a clearly thicker rim.
good: The calmest behind dense text: nearly even glass that is a little thicker toward the rim.
watch: So even that the one-big-pane character is hard to see at a glance.
